name: System info
description: Publish the Mac's own figures as status segments: one-second CPU snapshots with periodically refreshed GPU telemetry, one-second memory snapshots, three-second disk activity with capacity re-read on every mount change, one-second default-route traffic with network identity refreshed on every network change, and battery snapshots on power-source changes with TTL-bounded health. Every domain carries a summary, a label, structured hover details and raw numeric segments; summary_mode=full restores charts and secondary telemetry inline. Local addresses are copyable from @network.

commands.description: Show the latest CPU and GPU snapshot
Show current disk capacity and activity
Show current network traffic and addresses
Show current battery and power details
